WLS_all.bootstrap: paired resampling of towns with replacement; zero-date-variance resamples excluded

WLS_confirmation.bootstrap: paired resampling of towns with replacement; zero-date-variance resamples excluded

P1.interpretation: The predicted slope is the WLS slope of Alcyone theta at the observed town dates, with weights 1/(sigmaTheta^2+1deg^2). The mean local Alcyone rate is reported separately.

power.p_method: 2000 independent random permutations for each simulation, plus-one p; even for n <=9
power.date_evaluation: direct vector evaluation of space motion, precession and horizon iteration at every drawn year
power.optional_columns: Optional theta/rate columns are used for observed scores. Power evaluates our Alcyone model at drawn dates.

D1.interval_interpretation: The interval is compatible when it intersects [theta-2sigma,theta+2sigma]; full containment is also reported.
